paragraphs: Trane Technologies plc, a public limited company, incorporated in Ireland in 2009, and its consolidated subsidiaries (collectively we, us, our, the Company) is a global climate innovator. We bring sustainable and efficient solutions to buildings, homes and transportation through our strategic brands, Trane® and Thermo King®, and our environmentally responsible portfolio of products, services and connected intelligent controls. We generate revenue and cash primarily through the design, manufacture, sales and service of solutions for Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC), transport refrigeration, and custom refrigeration solutions. As an industry leader with an extensive global install base, our growth strategy includes expanding recurring revenue through services and rental options. Our unique business operating system, uplifting culture and highly engaged team around the world are also central to our earnings and cash flow growth.

Through our sustainability-focused strategy and purpose to boldly challenge what's possible for a sustainable world, we meet critical needs and growing global demand for innovation that reduces greenhouse gas emissions while enabling more efficient buildings and industry, and reliable delivery of essential temperature-controlled cargo. We have announced certain defined sustainability commitments with a goal of achieving these commitments by 2030 (2030 Sustainability Commitments). Trane Technologies' 2030 Sustainability Commitments include our 'Gigaton Challenge' to reduce customer greenhouse gas emissions by a billion metric tons; 'Leading by Example' through reducing embodied carbon by 40%, and designing products for circularity; and creating 'Opportunity for All' by investing in our people and our communities.
We operate under three reportable segments.

•Our Americas segment innovates for customers in North America and Latin America. The Americas segment encompasses commercial heating, cooling and ventilation systems, building controls and solutions, and energy services and solutions; residential heating and cooling; and transport refrigeration systems and solutions. This segment had 2025 net revenues of $17,168.8 million.

•Our EMEA segment innovates for customers in the Europe, Middle East and Africa region. The EMEA segment encompasses heating, cooling and ventilation systems and services, energy services and solutions, and transport refrigeration systems and solutions. This segment had 2025 net revenues of $2,802.1 million.

•Our Asia Pacific segment innovates for customers throughout the Asia Pacific region. The Asia Pacific segment encompasses heating, cooling and ventilation systems, services and solutions for commercial buildings and transport refrigeration systems and solutions. This segment had 2025 net revenues of $1,351.0 million.

paragraphs: Our business, financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows are subject to a number of risks that could cause the actual results and conditions to differ materially from those projected in forward-looking statements contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The risks set forth below are those we consider most significant. We face other risks, however, that we do not currently perceive to be material which could cause actual results and conditions to differ materially from our expectations. You should evaluate all risks before you invest in our securities. If any of the risks actually occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations or cash flows could be adversely impacted. In that case, the trading price of our ordinary shares could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment.

Our global operations are dependent upon products manufactured, purchased and sold in the U.S. and internationally. Approximately 75% of our net revenues in 2025 were derived inside the U.S., and we sold products in approximately 100 countries. In addition, many of our customers, manufacturing operations and suppliers are located outside the U.S. These activities are subject to risks that are inherent in operating globally, including:

•changes in local laws and regulations including potential imposition of currency restrictions; new or changing tax laws, including the implementation of a global minimum tax; variations in monetary policies; and other restraints;
•trade protection measures such as import or export restrictions and requirements, the imposition of tariffs and quotas, trade embargoes, or revocation or material modification of trade agreements;
•limitation of ownership rights, including expropriation of assets by a local government, and limitation on the ability to repatriate earnings;
•sovereign debt crises and currency instability in developed and developing countries;

paragraphs: The following Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results may differ materially from the results discussed in the forward-looking statements. Factors that might cause a difference include, but are not limited to, those discussed under Item 1A. Risk Factors in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The following section is qualified in its entirety by the more detailed information, including our financial statements and the notes thereto, which appears elsewhere in this Annual Report.

This section discusses 2025 and 2024 significant items affecting our consolidated operating results, financial condition and liquidity and provides a year-to-year comparison between 2025 and 2024. Discussions of 2023 significant items and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 have been excluded in this Form 10-K and can be found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for year ended December 31, 2024.

Trane Technologies plc is a global climate innovator. We bring sustainable and efficient solutions to buildings, homes and transportation through our strategic brands, Trane® and Thermo King®, and our environmentally responsible portfolio of products, services and connected intelligent controls.

Our commitment to sustainability extends to the environmental and social impacts of our people, operations, products and services. We have announced ambitious 2030 Sustainability Commitments, including our Gigaton Challenge to reduce customers' carbon emissions by a billion metric tons through sustainable products and services. We are also Leading by Example as we work toward carbon-neutral operations, zero waste-to-landfill and net positive water use in water-stressed locations. We also committed to reducing embodied carbon in our products by 40%, while also designing products for circularity. Our 2030 emissions reduction targets have been validated by the Science Based Targets Initiative (SBTi), and we are one of very few companies worldwide with validated 2050 net-zero targets. Finally, our Opportunity for All commitment focuses on investing in our people and our uplifting and inclusive culture, and broadening access to STEM education and careers in our communities.

On January 2, 2025, we completed the acquisition of BrainBox AI Inc., a building management platform for HVAC optimization, using advanced AI technologies. The results of the acquisition are reported within the Americas segment and are included in our consolidated financial statements from the date of the acquisition.
In the first half of 2025, we also acquired multiple distributors with sales and service businesses in Europe that are reported in the EMEA segment from the dates of acquisition.

Subsequent to the balance sheet date of December 31, 2025, the Company completed multiple acquisitions. The Company acquired two Transport refrigeration distributors with sales and service businesses that will be reported in the Americas and EMEA segments from their respective dates of acquisition. The Company also acquired a 49% interest in Kieback&Peter, a provider of building automation hardware, software and solutions across the building lifecycle and energy management. The Company's minority interest will be reported as an equity method investment within the EMEA segment.

On June 18, 2020 (Petition Date), our indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries, Aldrich and Murray each filed a voluntary petition for reorganization under the Bankruptcy Code. As a result of the Chapter 11 filings, all asbestos-related lawsuits against Aldrich and Murray have been stayed due to the imposition of a statutory automatic stay applicable in Chapter 11 bankruptcy cases. Only Aldrich and Murray have filed for Chapter 11 relief. Neither Aldrich's wholly-owned subsidiary, 200 Park, Murray's wholly-owned subsidiary, ClimateLabs, nor the Trane Companies are part of the Chapter 11 filings.

The goal of these Chapter 11 filings is to resolve equitably and permanently all current and future asbestos-related claims in a manner beneficial to claimants, Aldrich and Murray through court approval of a plan of reorganization that would create a trust pursuant to section 524(g) of the Bankruptcy Code, establish claims resolution procedures for all current and future asbestos-related claims against Aldrich and Murray and channel such claims to the trust for resolution in accordance with those procedures.

Aldrich and its wholly-owned subsidiary 200 Park and Murray and its wholly-owned subsidiary ClimateLabs were deconsolidated as of the Petition Date and their respective assets and liabilities were derecognized from our Consolidated Financial Statements.

On August 26, 2021, the Company announced that Aldrich and Murray reached an agreement in principle with the FCR in the bankruptcy proceedings. The agreement in principle includes the key terms for the permanent resolution of all current and future asbestos claims against Aldrich and Murray pursuant to a plan of reorganization (the Plan). Under the agreed terms, the Plan would create a trust pursuant to section 524(g) of the Bankruptcy Code and establish claims resolution procedures for all current and future claims against Aldrich and Murray (Asbestos Claims).

On September 24, 2021, Aldrich and Murray filed the Plan with the Bankruptcy Court. The Plan is supported by and reflects the agreement in principle reached with the FCR. On the same date, in connection with the Plan, Aldrich and Murray filed a motion to create a $270.0 million trust intended to constitute a "qualified settlement fund" within the meaning of the Treasury Regulations under Section 468B of the Internal Revenue Code (QSF). On January 27, 2022, the Bankruptcy Court granted the request to fund the QSF, which was funded on March 2, 2022, resulting in an operating cash outflow of $270.0 million reported in our Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, of which $91.8 million was allocated to continuing operations and $178.2 million was allocated to discontinued operations for the year ended December 31, 2022.

Certain individual claimants and the ACC filed Motions to dismiss the bankruptcy proceedings on April 6, 2023 and May 15, 2023, respectively (the Motions to Dismiss). The Bankruptcy Court denied the Motions to Dismiss, and the District Court and the Fourth Circuit declined to review the Bankruptcy Court's ruling. In addition, on January 23, 2023, an individual claimant filed a motion to lift the automatic stay imposed by the Bankruptcy Code to pursue its asbestos suit against Aldrich and Murray notwithstanding the Chapter 11 cases (the Stay Relief Motion). Aldrich and Murray, the FCR, and certain non-debtor affiliates each opposed the Stay Relief Motion. The Bankruptcy Court denied the Stay Relief Motion. The individual claimant filed a notice appealing the order denying the Stay Relief Motion to the U.S. District Court for the Western District of North Carolina (the District Court). The District Court has entered an order staying all deadlines in the appeal of the order denying the Stay Relief Motion pending the outcome of a separate appeal before the Fourth Circuit in another bankruptcy case pending in the Bankruptcy Court.

It is not possible to predict whether the Bankruptcy Court will approve the terms of the Plan, what the extent of the asbestos liability will be or how long the Chapter 11 cases will last. On December 17, 2025, the Bankruptcy Court granted the FCR's motion to streamline the Bankruptcy Court proceedings to estimate the Debtors' asbestos-related liabilities. The first phase of the estimation hearing will commence the week of August 10, 2026. The Chapter 11 cases remain pending as of February 5, 2026.

Trane Technologies plc，一家公開上市的有限公司，於愛爾蘭成立於2009年，及其合併子公司（ collectively we, us, our, the Company）為全球氣候創新領導者。我們透過戰略品牌Trane®與Thermo King®，以及我們環境責任的產品、服務與連線智慧控制解決方案，為建築、住宅與運輸提供可持續且高效的解決方案。我們主要透過設計、製造、銷售與服務 Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC)、運輸冷氣與客製冷氣解決方案來產生營業收入與現金流。作為行業領導者，擁有廣泛的全球安裝基礎，我們的成長策略包括透過服務與租賃選項來擴大重複性收入。我們獨特的業務運作系統、提升文化的團隊以及全球高度投入的團隊，也為我們的營收與現金流成長所不可或缺。

透過我們以永續為導向的策略與致力於挑戰可持續世界的願景，我們滿足關鍵需求與全球對創新成長的迫切需求，此創新可減少溫室氣體排放，同時提升建築與產業的效率，並確保關鍵溫度控制貨物的可靠運輸。我們已宣佈某些明確的永續承諾，目標於2030年達成這些承諾（2030 Sustainability Commitments）。Trane Technologies 的 2030 Sustainability Commitments 包括我們的 'Gigaton Challenge'，目標減少客戶溫室氣體排放量十億公噸；透過減少內在碳足跡40%，並設計產品以實現循環經濟的 'Leading by Example'；以及透過投資我們的員工與社區，創造 'Opportunity for All'。
我們運作於三個應報告分部。
• 我們的美洲應報告分部為北美洲與拉丁美洲的客戶創新。美洲應報告分部包含商業用供暖、冷氣與通風系統、建築控制與解決方案，以及能源服務與解決方案；住宅用供暖與冷氣；以及運輸用冷氣系統與解決方案。此分部於 2025 年的淨銷售額為 17,168.8 百萬美元。
•本公司歐洲、中東及非洲（EMEA）應報告分部為該地區的客戶創新，EMEA應報告分部包含供暖、冷氣與通風系統及服務、能源服務與解決方案，以及運輸冷氣系統與解決方案。此應報告分部於2025年的淨銷售額為28億零210萬美元。
•本公司亞太（Asia Pacific）應報告分部為該地區的客戶創新，亞太應報告分部包含商業建築的供暖、冷氣與通風系統、服務與解決方案，以及運輸冷氣系統與解決方案。此應報告分部於2025年的淨銷售額為13億5100萬美元。

Trane Technologies plc為全球氣候創新領導者。我們透過戰略品牌Trane®與Thermo King®，以及我們環境責任的產品、服務與連線智慧控制，為建築、住宅與運輸提供可持續且高效的解決方案。

我們對永續的承諾也延伸至我們員工、營運、產品與服務的環境與社會影響。我們已宣佈雄心勃勃的2030年永續承諾，包括Gigaton Challenge，透過可持續的產品與服務，協助客戶減少十億公噸的碳排放。我們也以身作則，朝向碳中和營運、零廢棄至垃圾場與在用水壓力高的地區實現淨正水使用努力。我們也承諾將產品的內在碳排放減少40%，同時設計具循環性的產品。我們的2030年減碳目標已由科學基準目標倡議組織（SBTi）驗證，我們是全球少數擁有驗證過的2050年淨零目標的公司。最後，我們的Opportunity for All承諾聚焦於投資員工與我們提升包容性的文化，並拓展社區的STEM教育與職業機會。
本公司於2025年1月2日完成對BrainBox AI Inc.的收購，該公司為一項用先進AI技術進行HVAC最佳化的建築管理平台。此收購的結果歸入美洲應報告分部，自收購日開始納入本公司合併財務報表。
在2025年上半年，本公司也收購了多個在歐洲擁有銷售與服務業務的經銷商，這些經銷商自收購日開始歸入EMEA應報告分部。
在2025年12月31日資產負債表日後，本公司完成了多項收購。本公司收購了兩家運輸冷氣經銷商，擁有銷售與服務業務，這些經銷商將自各自收購日開始歸入美洲與EMEA應報告分部。本公司也收購了Kieback&Peter 49%的股權，Kieback&Peter為提供建築自動化硬體、軟體與解決方案，涵蓋建築生命週期與能源管理的供應商。本公司少數股權將以權益法投資方式歸入EMEA應報告分部。

2020年6月18日（請願日），本公司間接全資子公司Aldrich與Murray各自向美國破產法典提出自願重組請願。因應第11章破產程序的申請，所有與Aldrich與Murray相關的石棉訴訟已被暫停，這是根據第11章破產案件中適用的法定自動暫停條款。僅Aldrich與Murray提出第11章救濟申請。Aldrich的全資子公司200 Park、Murray的全資子公司ClimateLabs，以及Trane Companies均未參與第13章破產程序。
本章第 11 章申報之目標係以公平且永久方式解決所有現有及未來與石棉相關之聲請，並對聲請人、Aldrich 及 Murray 有利，經法院批准重組計畫，該計畫將依 Bankruptcy Code 第 524(g) 節設立信託，並為所有現有及未來針對 Aldrich 及 Murray 之石棉相關聲請建立聲請解決程序，並依照該程序將聲請導入信託進行解決。
Aldrich 及其全資子公司 200 Park，以及 Murray 及其全資子公司 ClimateLabs，自聲請日已解除合併，其各自資產與負債已從我們之合併財務報表中移除。

2021 年 8 月 26 日，本公司宣佈 Aldrich 及 Murray 已與 FCR 在破產程序中達成原則性協議。此原則性協議包含針對所有現有及未來針對 Aldrich 及 Murray 之石棉聲請，依重組計畫（Plan）進行永久解決之關鍵條款。根據協議條款，Plan 將依 Bankruptcy Code 第 524(g) 節設立信託，並為所有現有及未來針對 Aldrich 及 Murray 之聲請（Asbestos Claims）建立聲請解決程序。

2021 年 9 月 24 日，Aldrich 及 Murray 向破產法院提交 Plan。此 Plan 係根據與 FCR 達成之原則性協議所制定。同日，為配合 Plan，Aldrich 及 Murray 提交動議，創設一個 2.7 億美元信託，意圖符合 Internal Revenue Code 第 468B 節之 Treasury Regulations 所定義之「合格和解基金」（QSF）。2022 年 1 月 27 日，破產法院批准資助 QSF，該基金於 2022 年 3 月 2 日完成資助，導致我們合併現金流量表中報告 2.7 億美元之營運現金流出，其中 9,180 萬美元歸屬於持續營運，17,820 萬美元歸屬於已終止營運，為 2022 年 12 月 31 日財務年度之數字。

若干個別聲請人及 ACC 於 2023 年 4 月 6 日及 2023 年 5 月 15 日分別提出動議，要求駁回破產程序（Motions to Dismiss）。破產法院駁回該動議，且地區法院及第四巡迴法院均未審查破產法院之裁決。此外，2023 年 1 月 23 日，個別聲請人提出動議，要求解除依破產法所設之自動中止，以繼續對 Aldrich 及 Murray 提起石棉訴訟，不論其 Chapter 11 破產程序（Stay Relief Motion）。Aldrich 及 Murray、FCR 及若干非債務人附屬公司均反對此 Stay Relief Motion。破產法院駁回此動議。個別聲請人已向美國北卡羅來納州西部地區法院（District Court）提出上訴通知，上訴針對駁回 Stay Relief Motion 之裁決。地區法院已發出命令，暫停所有上訴中針對駁回 Stay Relief Motion 之裁決之期限，待另一個破產案在破產法院進行之第四巡迴法院上訴結果出爐。
無法預測破產法院是否會批准 Plan 之條款、石棉責任之範圍為何，或 Chapter 11 破產程序將持續多久。2025 年 12 月 17 日，破產法院批准 FCR 之動議，以簡化破產程序，估計債務人之石棉相關責任。估計聽證會第一階段將於 2026 年 8 月 10 日當週開始。截至 2026 年 2 月 5 日，Chapter 11 破產程序仍持續進行中。

headings: 與經濟條件相關的風險
我們的全球營運使我們面臨經濟風險。
原物料短缺、供應鏈風險及價格上漲可能對我們的財務結果產生負面影響。
我們在所服務的市場面臨著顯著的競爭。
我們的成長部分取決於新產品與服務的及時開發、商業化與接受度。
資本與信貸市場條件可能對我們的營運、投資與財務表現產生負面影響。
貨幣兌換率波動及其他相關風險可能對我們的結果產生負面影響。
美國或外國貿易政策的變動及其他超出我們控制範圍的因素可能對我們的營運與營業成果產生負面影響。
世界地緣政治衝突已造成人道危機，對經濟活動造成重大影響，並可能對我們的全球及區域營運造成重大影響。
公共衛生危機對我們的影響程度將取決於未來發展，而這些發展高度不確定且無法準確預測。
與法律訴訟相關的風險
重大不利的法律判決、罰款、處罰或和解，可能會對我們的營運結果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
Aldrich 和 Murray 的第 11 章案件涉及各種風險與不確定性，這些風險與不確定性可能會對我們產生重大影響。
與網路安全及科技相關的風險
我們面臨與資訊科技系統相關的風險。
本公司或我們的供應商的資訊科技系統、基礎建設或產品發生安全 breach 或中斷，可能會對我們的業務及財務結果造成負面影響。
資料隱私權及保護法規持續演進，並帶來日益增加的合規挑戰。
他人智慧財產權侵佔聲請及本公司無法保護自身智慧財產權之權利，可能影響本公司之競爭地位。
與法規事項相關之風險
本公司聲譽、營運能力及營運成果可能因員工、代理人、商業夥伴或其他第三方之不當行為而受損。
本公司營運受法規風險影響。
全球氣候變遷及相關法規可能對本公司業務產生負面影響。
與本公司營運相關之風險
本公司業務之成功取決於吸引、培訓及留住高素質人才。
本公司業務可能因暫時性工廠停工、工會談判、勞資爭議及其他與勞動力相關事項而受到不利影響。

paragraphs: 本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果及現金流，受多項風險影響，可能導致實際結果與條件與本年度10-K表報表中所含之預測性陳述有重大差異。下列風險為本公司認為最重要之風險。然而，本公司尚面臨其他風險，目前認為非屬重大，但可能導致實際結果與條件與本公司預期有重大差異。投資人應在投資本公司證券前評估所有風險。若任何風險實際發生，可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果或現金流造成不利影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股之交易價格可能下跌，投資人可能損失全部或部分投資。
本公司之全球營運依賴於美國與國際間製造、購買新產品與銷售。2025年本公司約75%之淨銷售額來自美國境內，並在約100個國家銷售產品。此外，許多客戶、製造業務與供應商位於美國境外。這些活動受全球營運內在風險影響，包括：
•地方法律與法規之變動，包括可能實施貨幣限制；新或變更之稅法，包括全球最低稅之實施；貨幣政策之差異；及其他限制；
•貿易保護措施，如進口或出口限制與要求、關稅與配額之實施、貿易禁運，或貿易協議之廢止或重大修改；
•所有權權利之限制，包括地方政府沒收資產，以及限制將收益匯回之能力；
•發達與開發中國家之國家債務危機與貨幣不穩定；
